name: How much does exterior coating application cost compared to traditional painting?

mainEntity.name: How much does exterior coating application cost compared to traditional painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: While the initial cost of an exterior coating application is generally higher than traditional painting, it offers significant long-term value. Traditional paint often requires repainting every 3-7 years, incurring recurring material and labor expenses. Exterior coatings, with their 15-25 year lifespan, drastically reduce these repeat costs. The investment in an exterior coating can pay off over time through enhanced protection, reduced maintenance, and potentially increased home value, especially considering the higher durability required in areas like Pasadena's varied climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial exterior coating costs are higher than traditional painting, but provide better long-term value by lasting 15-25 years, reducing recurring expenses and offering superior protection.
